MAC APP STORE COMPANION

Closed-lid setup.

This optional companion sets up closed-lid mode for the Mac App Store edition of Dilated. Timers, triggers and Control Center work without it.

Download Closed-Lid Setup for Mac

Free. Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple Silicon. Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple.

Set it up

  1. Open the ZIP, then open Dilated Closed-Lid Setup.
  2. Review the setup details and choose Install. macOS asks for administrator approval.
  3. Return to Dilated and open Closed Lid. Enable closed-lid mode for the awake session you want to keep running.

What it installs

A sudo rule permits only /usr/bin/pmset -a disablesleep 0 and /usr/bin/pmset -a disablesleep 1. The companion also installs a script for the sandboxed app and a LaunchAgent that restores normal sleep if the app stops responding. The App Store app never downloads or installs the companion itself.

Open Closed-Lid Setup again to remove its setup. The direct-download edition of Dilated handles its own closed-lid setup and doesn't need this companion.

Keep your Mac ventilated

Closed-lid mode is experimental. Keep the Mac on a hard, ventilated surface. Don't put it in a bag while it is running. Battery, temperature and time limits can end a session.
